NM1 · THE NIGHT MARKET · PEARL OKONKWO

Stall Seventeen

New Spitalfields Market produce hall · The Princess of Wales · Roman Exchange

Half a delivery for stall seventeen went to the wrong customer, and the receiving clerk knows it. Pearl wants it traced before a gang of 'collectors' use the mistake to claim they run the traders.

Objectives

  1. Identify the order from the trader's case at the New Spitalfields produce hall (ticks itself)
  2. Bring the carrier and the mistaken buyer together at The Princess of Wales (ticks itself)
  3. See off the collector demanding a fee nobody agreed
  4. Settle it at the Roman Exchange (ticks itself)
  5. Decide: recover the load, buy the mistake, keep the good stuff, join the collectors or expose them

£80 crew fee3 XP+1 Renown · The Night Market+1 InfluenceOffer: Renown 0

How it plays

The job. Pearl wants a delivery traced before rival collectors use it to claim control over traders. A receiving clerk admits the wrong customer took part of it.

Scenes. An invented trader's case at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.69084b39c04899a0]{HM2.3} identifies the order. A fictional meeting at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.11347b4b484f139e]{CL2.2} brings the carrier and mistaken buyer together. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.0e780ec36ad51135]{OF7.2} is the final resale or restitution opportunity.

Route and checks. HM / CL / HC / WS / BG / OF. Front for settlement; Savvy for the order; Graft for a disputed collection.

Pressure

A collector arrives during trading hours to demand a fee nobody agreed. The next buyer is leaving with the goods after two enquiries.

The choice

Recover the load, buy the mistaken sale, keep a profitable item, join the collectors or expose their false authority.

What follows

A recognised outcome opens the market network. If the goods sell, the named buyer and unpaid obligation create another recovery route; the surrounding real market is not a unified faction.

One Box Two Buyers

Wilton Way Deli and Wines · Queensbridge Sound Store · Vortex Jazz Club

A record dealer and a sound-hire man both say the same box is theirs. One of the records inside is worth a lot more than vinyl. Pearl wants it sold before the row damages her network.

  2. Separate the record from the hire gear at the Queensbridge Sound Store (ticks itself)
  3. Meet the intended buyer at the Vortex late set (ticks itself)

Everything Must Go

Oddments Lockup · Clapton Library · The Canonbury Tavern

A house clearance came in with a missing man's watch among the teapots and photo albums. Pearl wants a good sale without buying a false ownership story along with it.

Objectives

  1. Go through the mixed load at the Oddments Lockup (ticks itself)
  2. Find the earlier owner at Clapton Library (ticks itself)
  3. Meet the pawner (or their man) at the collector's preview, The Canonbury Tavern (ticks itself)
  4. Decide: resell it all, return what can be identified, buy the title or sell a certificate

The clearance lorry loads while a claimant is at work. After the announced loading scene, its known buyer becomes the next recovery destination.

Complete the illicit resale, return identifiable belongings, buy the title or sell a convenient certificate to the bidder.

The accepted sale or recovery earns Pearl's recognition. This watch belongs to an independent disappearance; possession does not establish Nia's whereabouts or automatically prove murder.

Protection by Post

The Lord Morpeth · The Crooked Billet · Wickside Print Shop

Traders are getting printed demands for protection money in Stretch's name. Pearl doesn't believe Stretch writes letters. She wants the real author found before anyone pays.

Objectives

  2. Identify the collector using the name at The Crooked Billet (ticks itself)
  3. Trace the print order at the Wickside Print Shop (ticks itself)
  4. Follow the collection envelope through the evening gathering

Expose the false demand, steal the collection, join the protection business, negotiate a boundary or buy the intermediary's client list.

The recognised outcome secures routes and supports E5. A fleeing collector leaves the printer and payer as separate leads, while every unpaid trader remains an individual claimant.

The Market That Sold Itself

Essex Dry Goods · St Paul Old Ford · Carpenters Breakfast Club

Someone says the traders endorsed redevelopment. Pearl has never seen that agreement, and the residents remember signing for repairs.

Objectives

A Night to Trade

Clissold House · Rio Cinema · CRATE Brewery

Pearl wants to run a record-and-repair fair to fund the network's next move. A promoter will cover the shortfall — if he gets to run the programme.

Objectives

  1. Secure a backer at the Clissold House reception (ticks itself)
  2. Line up a screening and the recording owner at the Rio Cinema (ticks itself)
  3. Recover the missing projector and the master at CRATE Brewery (ticks itself)
  4. Open the doors, big or small

Where

Scenes. An invented reception at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.a720d397aea87d6a]{HB1.3} secures one backer. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.d54307367c0dc599]{DA1.4} supplies a screening and recording owner. A fictional crew's hire returns at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.383dbdd7a30c9ab9]{VW2.3} contain a missing projector and a master offered to a private buyer.

Route and checks. HB / CG / DA / HC / WS / VW. Graft for repairs and recovery; Front for event terms; Savvy for the valuable reel.

Pressure

A rival offers money to cancel the fair. Doors open after two preparation scenes, with a smaller programme still possible.

The choice

Hold an independent fair, take transparent sponsorship, sell exclusive access, fence the valuable reel or cancel and settle the bills.

What follows

A delivered fair creates a defined fund and a usable audience. A failed event leaves contracts, unpaid hires and a recording whose actual owner can still negotiate.

text.content:
NM8 · THE NIGHT MARKET · PEARL OKONKWO

Who Gets a Place at the Table

Roman Exchange · V&A East Museum · Saint Martha House

After the Quiet Hour, Pearl is offering the crew a real voice in the resale network. A private account from Nia, or her chosen representative, can make several deals at once.

Objectives

  1. Settle the outstanding goods claim at the Roman Exchange (ticks itself)
  2. Hear the displaced contributors at the V&A East event (ticks itself)
  3. Test the new trading agreement at Saint Martha House (ticks itself)
  4. Decide: an illicit exchange, a cooperative, a corporate concession, a split or sell your seat

£1000 crew fee5 XP+5 Renown · The Night Market+2 InfluenceOffer: Renown 20

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.0e780ec36ad51135]{OF7 Roman Exchange} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.7f001857f6166eed]{ST6 V&A East Museum} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN7 Saint Martha House} MAPPED

How it plays

The job. Pearl offers the crew a formal voice in the resale network after the Quiet Hour. A private account from Nia or her chosen representative makes several deals possible.

Scenes. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.0e780ec36ad51135]{OF7.2} settles an outstanding goods claim. An invented public-history event at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.7f001857f6166eed]{ST6.3} hears displaced contributors. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN7.4} tests a new trading agreement against a funded independent alternative.

Route and checks. OF / BF / ST / ON / LY / HM / CL / SN. Front for trading terms; Savvy for obligations; Bottle when silence is profitable.

Pressure

A trader excluded from the final deal arrives with a real unpaid claim. A corporate buyer offers more if the crew keeps that dispute out of the public account.

The choice

Keep a profitable illicit exchange, build a cooperative, accept a corporate concession, divide the network or sell the crew's position.

What follows

The final rank grants a defined brokerage role or concession share. Record the actual stock, premises, fees and dissenting traders who remain free to become rivals.

FACTION · BM

Borough Mutual

Rosa Baptiste. Food, practical support, housing, worker solidarity and witness choice.

The Mutual wants people to remain able to live in their neighbourhoods. It can work with a criminal crew on a useful task without excusing that crew's other actions. Its influence comes from people deciding to cooperate, not from controlling every resident.

Bases @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN7 Saint Martha House [MAPPED]} / @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b7a4eb23ff167c1b]{BF8 Carpenters Breakfast Club [MAPPED]}

People and division

Tenant Adele Mensah wants concrete guarantees; advocate Tariq Evans protects individual consent; organiser Gwen Price wants a funded future. Some members accept a funded move. Others want a cooperative bid or a public challenge. Rosa will not pretend a popular speech creates a home, a job or enough money to keep a building.

Trust and repair

Exposing a person's private account against agreed terms or taking resources promised to a household strains trust. Repair means concrete restitution and the person's choice to re-engage.

What Renown earns

R3a named organiser contact
R7invitations to planning meetings
R12coordination of one funded project
R18a representative voice with stated limits
R25an accountable community mandate.
Spending Influence

1 an introduction or agreed practical task; 2 temporary support from an available volunteer or a booked room; 4 a coordinated campaign or support effort with resources and beneficiaries named.

Places that open

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN7} opens a recurring kitchen and advice meeting; @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b7a4eb23ff167c1b]{BF8} adds resident negotiations. A leadership seat needs the users support and an affordable room budget.

pages.name: BM1 · A Meal and a Receipt

text.content:
BM1 · BOROUGH MUTUAL · ROSA BAPTISTE

A Meal and a Receipt

Saint Martha House · Chicken Palace · HBC Community Centre

Rosa needs a household helped through two debt collectors at once — one debt is real, one is invented. Meanwhile Mo is waiting on the food delivery he was promised for the Chicken Palace.

Objectives

  1. Collect the delivery and Rosa's terms at Saint Martha House (ticks itself)
  2. Get the meal to Mo at the Chicken Palace (ticks itself)
  3. Put the debtor, the receipt and the collector in one room at the HBC advice evening (ticks itself)
  4. Decide: negotiate a pause, pay the real debt, take the collector's cash, expose the fake or enforce it for a fee

£80 crew fee3 XP+1 Renown · Borough Mutual+1 InfluenceOffer: Renown 0

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN7 Saint Martha House} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.ce26d88c705b4b63]{FL1 Chicken Palace} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.9f4c6205e899377d]{WW2 HBC Community Centre} MAPPED

How it plays

The job. Rosa wants a household helped through two competing collections while Mo needs a promised food delivery. One debt is real and one was invented.

Scenes. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN7.1} provides the delivery and Rosa's terms. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.ce26d88c705b4b63]{FL1} brings the problem to the crew's existing home. A fictional advice evening at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.9f4c6205e899377d]{WW2.3} puts the debtor, receipt and collector in one room.

Route and checks. SN / CL / HC / WW. Moves for the delivery; Front for the household; Bottle under collection pressure.

Pressure

Daz wants an immediate example while Mo expects the meal delivered. An ally can take one actual task if the crew gives them the means.

The choice

Negotiate a pause, pay the genuine balance, steal the collector's cash, expose the duplicate or take a private fee to enforce it.

What follows

The accepted help opens Mutual work and @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN7}'s meeting space. A missed delivery remains a practical obligation, while the collector's response depends on witnesses and the chosen settlement.

BM2 · BOROUGH MUTUAL · ROSA BAPTISTE

Benefit Night Rain Check

Leyton Jubilee Park pavilion · St Paul's West Hackney · Hackney Empire · Haggerston Community Centre

Rosa's benefit night has lost its room, its sound case and its fee in one afternoon. It's raining. She needs a programme that works and someone to carry what it still costs.

Objectives

  1. Find the double booking at the Leyton Jubilee Park pavilion (ticks itself)
  2. Check the smaller room at St Paul's West Hackney (ticks itself)
  3. Get the stage case back from the Hackney Empire before it leaves (ticks itself)
  4. Pull together performers at Haggerston Community Centre (ticks itself)
  5. Decide: recover the case, hire a replacement, combine the nights, take sponsor money or cancel

£120 crew fee3 XP+2 Renown · Borough Mutual+1 InfluenceOffer: Renown 1

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.69084b39c04899a0]{HM6 Leyton Jubilee Park pavilion} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN6 St Paul's West Hackney} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b2b52ca96e6558d1]{HC1 Hackney Empire} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b1c3f967b6aa7594]{HR4 Haggerston Community Centre} MAPPED

How it plays

The job. A fictional benefit has lost its booked room, sound case and promised fee. Rosa needs a workable programme and someone willing to carry the remaining costs.

Scenes. A fictional organiser in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.69084b39c04899a0]{HM6.4} identifies the double booking. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN6.3} offers a smaller room. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b2b52ca96e6558d1]{HC1.5} holds the missing stage case; an invented planning meeting at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b1c3f967b6aa7594]{HR4.3} supplies local performers or an alternative show.

Route and checks. HM / CL / SN / CL / HC / DA / LF / HR. Front for the programme; Graft for the case; Moves for moving the act.

Pressure

Rain drives two audiences into too little space. The case leaves on another truck after the second scene; the doors then open on whatever programme the crew agreed.

The choice

Recover the case, buy a limited replacement, combine the events, use a sponsor's conditions or cancel and settle the actual contracts.

What follows

A delivered programme opens one funded community resource and repeat venue contacts. Failure leaves particular workers, guests and creditors who can make later offers.

BM3 · BOROUGH MUTUAL · ROSA BAPTISTE

The Signatures Upstairs

St John of Jerusalem · Dalston CLR James Library · Roman Rooms Printworks

A petition for repairs is being passed off as a mandate for redevelopment. Rosa wants the original kept safe before everyone who signed it is counted as a yes.

Objectives

  1. Get a tenant's copy at St John of Jerusalem (ticks itself)
  2. Find the first printed version at Dalston CLR James Library (ticks itself)
  3. Find the proof, and who ordered the new wording, at the Roman Rooms Printworks (ticks itself)
  4. Decide: steal or keep the proof, challenge the account, negotiate funded terms or sell the list

£160 crew fee3 XP+2 Renown · Borough Mutual+1 InfluenceOffer: Renown 3

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.25c01e80cc3ba50e]{WS5 St John of Jerusalem} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.d54307367c0dc599]{DA6 Dalston CLR James Library} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.0e780ec36ad51135]{OF8 Roman Rooms Printworks} MAPPED

How it plays

The job. A repair petition is being presented as a redevelopment mandate. Rosa wants the original preserved before its signatories are treated as one consenting bloc.

Scenes. An invented meeting in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.25c01e80cc3ba50e]{WS5.3} supplies a tenant's copy. A public enquiry at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.d54307367c0dc599]{DA6.4} identifies the campaign's first printed version. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.0e780ec36ad51135]{OF8.3} holds the proof and the visitor who ordered the later wording.

Route and checks. WS / HC / DA / HC / WS / BG / OF. Savvy for the print history; Front for the meeting; Moves for a disputed collection.

Pressure

A collector arrives for the original as the residents' meeting becomes heated. One group prefers a move and another wants to stay.

The choice

Steal or preserve the proof, challenge the false account, negotiate funded terms or sell the signature list to a paying rival.

What follows

The agreed correction or settlement supports E1. Taken originals leave independent signatories and the print worker, while a sale creates a concrete buyer who can use the information later.

BM4 · BOROUGH MUTUAL · ROSA BAPTISTE

After the Batch

Approach Recovery Rooms · Ambulance Bay · Majors · The Spread Eagle

People hurt by the bad Halo need lifts, support and a say in the story being sold in their names. Rosa's brief is practical: get them help first.

Objectives

  1. Find out one person's immediate need at the Approach Recovery Rooms (ticks itself)
  2. Get them to Homerton A&E (ambulance bay, then Majors) (ticks itself)
  3. Link the harm to the changed delivery through the courier at The Spread Eagle (ticks itself)
  4. Decide: the passenger first, an ally on the cargo, a public account, a private witness or the hush money

£240 crew fee3 XP+3 Renown · Borough Mutual+1 InfluenceOffer: Renown 5

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.78f07d621cc24fad]{BG8 Approach Recovery Rooms} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.ce26d88c705b4b63]{AE1 Ambulance Bay} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.ce26d88c705b4b63]{AE3 Majors} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.9f4c6205e899377d]{WW4 The Spread Eagle} MAPPED

The job. People harmed by Halo need transport, support and a decision about the account being sold in their names. Rosa offers a practical recovery brief.

Scenes. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.78f07d621cc24fad]{BG8.2} identifies one person's immediate need. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.ce26d88c705b4b63]{AE1} and @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.ce26d88c705b4b63]{AE3} use the existing hospital map for the journey and a later independent account. A fictional courier at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.9f4c6205e899377d]{WW4.2} connects the harm to the changed delivery.

Route and checks. BG / WS / HC / WW. Wheels for transport; Front for the competing brief; Savvy for corroboration.

Pressure

Another faction wants the crew to chase the remaining stock instead. Use a disclosed journey deadline only when the existing patient rules and the fiction call for it.

The choice

Prioritise the passenger, assign a paid ally to the cargo, sell a public account, protect a private witness or accept a suppression fee and its consequences.

What follows

A fulfilled support brief earns Rosa's trust. Independent accounts support E2; choosing another patron can earn their reward while leaving Rosa's actual promised task unfinished.

text.content:
BM5 · BOROUGH MUTUAL · ROSA BAPTISTE

The Homes on the List

Clapton Union Rooms · White Post Workers Rooms · Carpenters Breakfast Club

Three occupied premises got near-identical offers after three different 'incidents'. Rosa wants every household to know what was promised — and what can really happen next.

Objectives

  1. Get the early repair account at the Clapton Union Rooms (ticks itself)
  2. Sit in on the divided residents' meeting at the White Post Workers Rooms (ticks itself)
  3. Find the relocation letter at the Carpenters Breakfast Club (ticks itself)
  4. Stop the contractor moving belongings on a false vacancy
  5. Decide: help people stay, negotiate a move, recover belongings, back the buyer or take one signature's fee

£320 crew fee5 XP+3 Renown · Borough Mutual+1 InfluenceOffer: Renown 8

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.11347b4b484f139e]{CL8 Clapton Union Rooms} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.383dbdd7a30c9ab9]{VW8 White Post Workers Rooms} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b7a4eb23ff167c1b]{BF8 Carpenters Breakfast Club} MAPPED

How it plays

The job. Three fictional occupied premises receive similar offers after different incidents. Rosa wants each group to know what was promised and what can actually happen next.

Scenes. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.11347b4b484f139e]{CL8.3} supplies the early repair account. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.383dbdd7a30c9ab9]{VW8.3} holds a divided residents' meeting. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b7a4eb23ff167c1b]{BF8.4} reveals the relocation letter and a household's funded alternative.

Route and checks. CL / HC / WS / VW / OF / BF. Front for different needs; Muscle for moving or confrontation; Savvy for the matched offers.

Pressure

A contractor starts moving belongings under a false vacancy account. A worker will pause if shown the actual dispute, while a collector demands the job continue.

The choice

Help people stay, negotiate a move, recover disputed possessions, back the buyer or take a private fee for one household's signature.

What follows

The accepted settlement supports E1. A rushed clearance creates displaced owners with contacts elsewhere, rather than erasing the premises or automatically solving every other property dispute.

pages.name: BM6 · Who Can Promise a Home

text.content:
BM6 · BOROUGH MUTUAL · ROSA BAPTISTE

Who Can Promise a Home

Newington Green Meeting House · Essex Dry Goods · Hackney Town Hall

Rosa needs a coalition that can actually stop the acquisitions. A lawyer, the workers and a public meeting all bring a different kind of muscle.

Objectives

  1. Meet the counter-proposal and its backers at Newington Green Meeting House (ticks itself)
  2. Agree the workers' terms at Essex Dry Goods (ticks itself)
  3. Make the one speaking slot count at Hackney Town Hall (ticks itself)
  4. Decide: a cooperative bid, an exit, steal the option, expose the report or endorse Meridian

£480 crew fee5 XP+4 Renown · Borough Mutual+1 InfluenceOffer: Renown 11

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.cbb65680f5cc95c5]{CG1 Newington Green Meeting House} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.5b42c691f95a7c91]{DB8 Essex Dry Goods} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.25c01e80cc3ba50e]{WS1 Hackney Town Hall} MAPPED

How it plays

The job. Rosa needs a feasible coalition to resist the acquisitions. A lawyer, workers and a public meeting offer different kinds of leverage.

The coalition has one slot and two incompatible proposals. A financier will fund only one if the crew names the continuing liabilities.

The choice

Back a cooperative bid, negotiate an exit, steal the relevant option for leverage, expose the report or endorse Meridian for a private role.

The Lantern Desk

DS Harriet Vale. A fictional small investigative network and source relationship, not membership of a real police force.

Vale wants a supported account of linked thefts, harm and official misconduct. She may become an ally or adversary depending on the crew's choices. Her access is limited and her institutional interests can conflict with a witness's desire for privacy.

People and division

PC Isla Dunn wants her original note heard; Inspector Gavin Holt wants inconvenient accounts contained. Vale's caution competes with her ambition. Dunn fears becoming a scapegoat. Holt has taken consultancy money and helped suppress accounts, but cannot control every officer or every record.

Trust and repair

A proven false statement or betrayal of an agreed source strains Vale's cooperation. Declining to act as a source is permitted and does not itself prove guilt.

LD8 · THE LANTERN DESK · DS HARRIET VALE

A Case That Survives Its Witnesses

Interview Room · Hackney Town Hall · Lantern Case Flat

Objectives

  2. Make the account at the Hackney Town Hall review (ticks itself)

The choice

Build a public case, expose misconduct through the station, keep a private dossier, bargain for a limited result or end the relationship.

FACTION · MR

Meridian Renewal

Celia Voss. Fictional redevelopment, private enforcement, patronage and manufactured public narratives.

Meridian wants cheap control of six occupied premises and a funding deal it can sell as successful regeneration. Celia has approved false vacancy accounts and coercive pressure. She thinks visible investment will make people tolerate the means used to deliver it.

Bases @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.7f001857f6166eed]{ST7 Meridian Sales Pavilion [MAPPED]} / @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.51d4cafdaaaa0837]{ON8 North Park Hospitality Lodge [MAPPED]}

People and division

Security chief Martin Rusk wants control; surveyor Esther Cole wants truthful work; intermediary Evan Lark handles the unattractive details. Rusk has escalated intimidation and paid for deception. Esther and other workers want real professional work. Investors can accept reform if someone funds it; replacing Celia does not automatically dissolve the contracts.

Trust and repair

Secretly selling Meridian's agreed commission to a rival makes the relevant executive hostile. A disclosed counterproposal can be accepted if it meets actual obligations and has support.

MR8 · MERIDIAN RENEWAL · CELIA VOSS

The City on the Brochure

Meridian Sales Pavilion · Stoke Newington Town Hall · Quayline Records Suite · Carpenters Breakfast Club

After the Quiet Hour, Celia offers the crew a permanent place in the redevelopment business. Investors, residents and rivals each bring their own version of the deal.

Objectives

  1. Establish the real capital and your share at the Meridian Sales Pavilion (ticks itself)
  2. Hear the competing account at Stoke Newington Town Hall (ticks itself)
  3. Resolve the intermediary's liabilities at the Quayline Records Suite (ticks itself)
  4. Test one promise at the Carpenters Breakfast Club (ticks itself)
  5. Decide: patronage, a share, reform, a new buyer, exposure or an independent alternative

Route and checks. ST / ON / LY / HM / CL / SN / HB / CG / DA / HC / WS / BG / OF / BF. Front for the settlement; Savvy for the supported account; Bottle for a public position.

Pressure

A funded rival offer arrives before signatures. Its beneficiaries differ from the coalition the crew previously endorsed, and one creditor will not wait.

The choice

Take a patronage role, buy a share, negotiate reform, sell to a new buyer, expose the scheme or back a funded independent alternative.

FACTION · RT

The Red Thread

Ada Index March. Missing people, archives, investigative work and the ownership of a public story.

The Red Thread wants the city's missing and misrepresented people to retain a voice. It investigates through conversations, corroboration and the recovery of contested material. Its members disagree about when publicity helps and when it puts someone in danger.

Bases @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.5b42c691f95a7c91]{DB7 Split Second Archive [MAPPED]} / @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.5a3e0570dd504786]{LF8 Englefield Listening Flat [MAPPED]}

People and division

Noel Harris values oral history; solicitor Zoe Akande insists on clear agreements; Nia Bell refuses to be reduced to a missing-person poster. Index wants a durable record. Some contributors want an exclusive story that will fund future work. Others would rather settle privately than become the face of a cause.

Trust and repair

Publishing a supported account is different from selling someone else's private location. Breaking an agreed boundary requires a correction, restitution and the person's independent choice to return.

What Renown earns

RankBenefit
R3a researcher introduction
R7scheduled archive help
R12access to cleared case material
R18a voice in publication strategy
R25defined stewardship of a shared investigative network.
Spending Influence

1 identifying a willing source or known record; 2 focused research or an agreed interview session; 4 independent keepers convene a protected testimony or archive agreement.

A Pillar reward is agreed stewardship and publication terms for the fictional archive.

The Empty Slot

St Peter de Beauvoir · Split Second Archive · Abney Park Chapel · Dalston CLR James Library

Index wants Nia found — without the crew buying every rumour going. So far there's a poster someone took down, a reel nobody can find and an old programme credit.

  2. Find the missing catalogue entry at the Split Second Archive

  4. Find the credit, and a surviving contact, at Dalston CLR James Library (ticks itself)
  5. Decide: a public appeal, a quiet search, an exclusive fee, steal the reel or sell the contact

£80 crew fee3 XP+1 Renown · The Red Thread+1 InfluenceOffer: Renown 0

The job. Index asks the crew to find Nia without buying every rumour. A removed poster, missing reel and old programme credit are the first reliable leads.

Scenes. A fictional evening meeting at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.5b42c691f95a7c91]{DB1.3} introduces the concerned friend. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.5b42c691f95a7c91]{DB7.3} supplies the missing catalogue entry. An invented recording event at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN1.2} identifies an old voice; @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.d54307367c0dc599]{DA6.4} locates the public credit and a surviving contact.

Run a public appeal, work quietly, take an exclusive search fee, steal the offered reel or sell the first credible contact to another faction.

The Watch After Midnight

Clapton Library · The Clapton Hart · The Prince Arthur · Hub67

A missing woman's watch was pawned weeks after she supposedly left London. The pawner swears it was an ordinary sale. Index wants the woman found — if she wants to be.

Objectives

  2. Meet the friend who bought it at The Clapton Hart
  3. Get the handover invitation at The Prince Arthur (ticks itself)
  4. Meet the owner, or her ally, at the Hub67 screening — if she chooses to (ticks itself)
  5. Decide: return the watch, sell the address, protect her leaving, expose the claim or carry a message home

The job. A missing person's watch was pawned after they supposedly left London. Index wants the person found; the pawner says it was an ordinary sale.

Scenes. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.11347b4b484f139e]{CL1.4} identifies the older owner. A fictional meeting at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.11347b4b484f139e]{CL4.2} introduces the friend who bought it. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.5a3e0570dd504786]{LF2.3} supplies a handover invitation; an invented screening at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.9f4c6205e899377d]{WW6.3} offers a voluntary meeting with the owner or their ally.

The choice

RT3 · THE RED THREAD · ADA "INDEX" MARCH

A Photograph Without a Caption

Sutton House · Museum of the Home · The Wenlock Arms

An old station photograph seems to show a current sponsor under a different name. Index wants the people and the connection checked properly — a wrong name here would ruin an innocent person.

Objectives

  1. See the photograph at the Sutton House loan viewing (ticks itself)
  2. Identify the old programme at the Museum of the Home oral-history evening (ticks itself)
  3. Get the original ticket from the repair contact at The Wenlock Arms (ticks itself)
  4. Decide: publish what holds up, steal the original, keep it private, sell it or trade the name

How it plays

The job. An old station photograph appears to identify a current sponsor under another professional name. Index wants the people and connection verified.

Scenes. An invented loan viewing in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b2b52ca96e6558d1]{HC3.4} introduces the photograph. A fictional oral-history evening at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b1c3f967b6aa7594]{HR1.3} identifies the old programme. A visiting repair contact at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.357679fcd032b6ef]{HX1.2} has the case's original ticket and the intended recipient.

Route and checks. HC / DA / LF / HR / HX. Savvy for provenance; Front for contributors; Bottle against the convenient suspect.

Pressure

A collector buys the photo while an older contributor is on the way. A mistaken identification would create a powerful public story and a real innocent target.

The choice

Publish the supported history, steal the original, preserve a private account, sell it to a collector or trade the intermediary's identity.

What follows

The corroborated connection identifies Evan Lark of Quayline and opens RT4. A changed name alone proves little; a lost photo leaves the loan inventory and repair history.

The Night That Repeated

Silt Listening Bunker · Grow Hackney · Wallis Tape Rooms · Hackney Picturehouse

RT5 · THE RED THREAD · ADA "INDEX" MARCH

Six Addresses Before the Trouble

Orchard Lease Office · Clapton Union Rooms · Roman Rooms Printworks

Index has found premises listed for acquisition before the 'incidents' that were used to justify buying them. The crew needs to prove the timing — not assume every deal was crooked.

Objectives

  1. Find the early option at the Orchard Lease Office (ticks itself)
  2. Get the tenant's own copy at the Clapton Union Rooms (ticks itself)
  3. Date the first print proof at the Roman Rooms Printworks (ticks itself)
  4. Deal with Lark's offer to buy the file
  5. Decide: build the case, sell a warning, steal an option, let a buyer profit or keep the timing for later

How it plays

The job. Index finds fictional occupied premises listed before the incidents used to justify their acquisition. The crew must establish the timing rather than assume every deal was fraudulent.

Scenes. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.a720d397aea87d6a]{HB8.4} supplies an early option. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.11347b4b484f139e]{CL8.3} provides a tenant's independent copy. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.0e780ec36ad51135]{OF8.3} dates the first print proof and identifies who ordered the later account. The other targets are @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.5b42c691f95a7c91]{DB8}, @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.383dbdd7a30c9ab9]{VW8} and BF8.

Route and checks. HB / SN / CL / HC / WS / BG / OF. Savvy for dates; Front for competing accounts; Bottle against the sponsor's offer.

Pressure

Lark offers to buy the file as routine clearance work. One resident genuinely supports investment and will contradict an exaggerated public claim.

The choice

Build the supported case, sell a warning, steal an option, let an interested buyer profit or keep the timing private for negotiations.

What follows

Corroboration establishes E1. A lost document makes another of the six addresses useful; real occupants remain active sources and potential employers after the central truth becomes public.

RT6 · THE RED THREAD · ADA "INDEX" MARCH

The Woman Who Chose to Vanish

Willow Cabin · Discharge Lounge · Evering Safe Flat

Nia is alive, at the Willow Cabin. Index wants a meeting. Asha wants to know what the crew plans to do with Nia's account before she helps any further.

Objectives

  1. Hold the first conversation at the Willow Cabin (ticks itself)
  2. Meet the corroborator in the A&E discharge lounge (ticks itself)
  3. Find out the price of the Evering safe flat (ticks itself)

How it plays

Route and checks. WW / HC / CL / SN. Front for trust; Wheels for an onward journey; Bottle for keeping a costly boundary.

Pressure

A driver arrives with an immediate relocation offer. If Nia has already left, her message at @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.9f4c6205e899377d]{WW7} points to her current supporter rather than an empty-room dead end.

The choice

Respect a limited statement, secure an exclusive, arrange independent protection, sell the location or trade the testimony for another faction's support.

What follows

An actual meeting or authorised account establishes E4. Betrayal narrows future access while Nia's earlier recordings, friends and independent witnesses keep the larger mystery playable.

RT8 · THE RED THREAD · ADA "INDEX" MARCH

A Record of What Happened

pages.name: S01 · The Voice at the Book Club

text.content:
S01 · LOCAL CASE · JONAH MILLS

The Voice at the Book Club

The Old Church · St Mary's New Church · The Rose and Crown

The Highbury book club recorded last week's meeting. On the tape, a member who died two years ago comments on it. Jonah would like to know how, before the club sells its archive.

Objectives

  1. Hear the tape at The Old Church (ticks itself)
  2. Compare the older programme at St Mary's New Church
  3. Confront the surviving member at the Rose and Crown gathering
  4. Decide: expose the edit, arrange an informed sale or keep a shared archive

£120 crew fee3 XP+1 Renown · Dead Air Collective or Borough Mutual

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.a720d397aea87d6a]{HB2 The Old Church} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.a720d397aea87d6a]{HB3 St Mary's New Church} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.a720d397aea87d6a]{HB6 The Rose and Crown} MAPPED

How it plays

The offer. Jonah Mills hires the crew after a club recording seems to contain a dead member commenting on last week's meeting.

The truth (GM). A living former member has spliced a private joke into the recording to stop a collector buying the club's archive. The collector is innocent of the deception and genuinely wants the material.

Scenes. Hear the tape in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.a720d397aea87d6a]{HB2.3}, compare the older event programme in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.a720d397aea87d6a]{HB3.5}, then confront the surviving member during the gathering in HB6.3. Leon can identify the repeated phrase without needing a successful roll.

Atlas route. HB (one district: every scene is on this street map)

Pressure

The collector arrives during the next meeting. If the crew waits, the club votes on an uninformed sale; the member may confess after a friend recognises the joke.

Outcome and reward

Expose the edit, arrange an informed sale or persuade the members to keep a shared archive. A completed commission earns GBP 120 and 1 AD or BM Renown once; repeat access is an agreed meeting booking.

pages.name: S02 · The Alarm Before the Song

text.content:
S02 · LOCAL CASE · THE CONCERT ORGANISER

Abney Park Chapel · The Shacklewell Arms · Abney Books

The only copy of an unreleased song has gone, and someone keeps setting off a screaming portable alarm in rehearsals. The organiser needs both problems gone before the gig.

Objectives

  1. Search the hired rehearsal room at Abney Park Chapel (ticks itself)
  2. Interview the visiting crew at the Shacklewell Arms
  3. Follow the note in the borrowed book to Abney Books
  4. Decide: steal the master back, settle the wages, sell the song or stage an honest replacement

£160 crew fee3 XP+1 Renown · Dead Air Collective or The Velvet Circuit

Where

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN1 Abney Park Chapel} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN5 The Shacklewell Arms} MAPPED@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN2 Abney Books} MAPPED

How it plays

The offer. A fictional concert organiser has lost the only copy of an unreleased song. Somebody has also been setting off an invented portable alarm during rehearsals.

The truth (GM). Adult stage assistant Miri Dane hid the master to recover unpaid wages. A rival promoter is using the disturbance to poach the concert, without knowing where the song went.

Scenes. Search the hired rehearsal room @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN1.3}, interview the visiting crew in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN5.5} and follow a note tucked in a borrowed book to SN2.3. Miri brings the master to the final sound check.

Pressure

After two scenes the rival offers an immediate replacement act. Accepting it saves the booking but gives the original performers a claim against the organiser.

Outcome and reward

Steal the master back, settle the wage claim, sell the song or stage an honest replacement. GBP 160 and 1 AD or VC Renown once for the agreed outcome; @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.f1da74521bed61fd]{SN5} offers future paid sound work.

text.content:

The Princess of Wales · The Clapton Hart · The Elderfield

A passenger borrowed a bag off a Lea boat and vanished. Now two brothers are giving each other's names, and each one says the other has the bag.

Meet the owner in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.11347b4b484f139e]{CL2.2}, discover the brothers' different stories in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.11347b4b484f139e]{CL4.3}, then catch the attempted sale in CL6.3. Pressure

The musician arrives at the sale with a rival recovery crew. A chase can move onto the mapped Lea-side approach; any additional boat cabin is MAPPED and optional.

Outcome and reward

Recover the instrument, buy it for the musician or negotiate a paid cancellation. GBP 160 and 1 TU or NM Renown once; the boat owner becomes a limited passenger contact, not a free vehicle.

pages.name: S04 · The Dog at the Fundraiser

text.content:
S04 · LOCAL CASE · THE FUNDRAISER ORGANISER

£120 crew fee3 XP+1 Renown · Borough Mutual or The Backroom Bookmakers

Where

The offer. A fictional sports fundraiser loses its prize greyhound and cash tin. The organiser hires the crew before accusing a volunteer publicly.

The truth (GM). The dog followed familiar food into a delivery. Adult volunteer Ellis took the tin to stop a threatened seizure for a separate debt, then panicked.

Scenes. Follow the dog's carrier from @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.69084b39c04899a0]{HM1.2} to a consenting fictional trader in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.69084b39c04899a0]{HM2.3}, then find Ellis preparing an explanation in HM6.4. The fundraiser begins after two searches. A hired collector demands the tin and threatens Ellis's own possessions if the debt remains unresolved.

Outcome and reward

Return the dog and funds, contest the collector's claim or let Ellis admit the theft and bargain. GBP 120 and 1 BM or BB Renown once; both pavilions can offer future event bookings.

The offer. A supporter group hires the crew to retrieve its mascot costume and ticket money before a fictional match-day event.

The truth (GM). A former volunteer borrowed the costume for a private appearance. Their ex-partner took the ticket wallet as leverage over a shared loan; neither belongs to Meridian.

Scenes. Question the volunteer in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b096f49f5fcfe272]{LY2.4}, recover the costume during a private booking in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b096f49f5fcfe272]{LY6.3}, then reach @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b096f49f5fcfe272]{LY1.2} before an opportunist uses the missing tickets. At kick-off the tickets lose their face value and a rival mascot claims the appearance fee. A late recovery still clears the volunteer's name if the money is accounted for.

Return everything, keep the appearance fee or negotiate a smaller settlement. GBP 120 and 1 BB or CH Renown once; an event steward can invite the crew back for paid match work.

pages.name: S06 · The Cat in the Catalogue

text.content:
S06 · LOCAL CASE · CLEMENT WREN

A collector's missing cat has turned up in a photograph taken at an art sale. Wren will pay for the cat — and for an explanation of why the sale catalogue doesn't match itself.

Where

The offer. An adult collector's missing cat appears in a photograph taken during an art sale. Wren offers payment for the animal and an explanation of a switched catalogue.

The truth (GM). A junior fictional dealer has been selling reproductions as originals. The cat wandered into the packing room and was taken home by an unwitting temporary worker.

Scenes. Hear the collector in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.cbb65680f5cc95c5]{CG1.4}, compare the private catalogue over a meeting in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.cbb65680f5cc95c5]{CG3.2}, then confront the fictional dealer during a hired viewing in CG2.3. The dealer plans to leave with a deposit after the viewing. If warned too early, they offer the crew a share of the sale and a different object as cover.

Recover the cat, stop the fraud, steal the deposit or negotiate restitution. GBP 160 and 1 GE or NM Renown once; a recurring appraisal appointment is possible after the owner is repaid.

Examine the abandoned set in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.d54307367c0dc599]{DA2.4}, meet the performer in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.d54307367c0dc599]{DA4.5} and catch the would-be buyer in DA3.4. Use the mapped flat's @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.ce26d88c705b4b63]{FL1} and @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.ce26d88c705b4b63]{FL3} to establish what is missing, meet the false buyer in @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b2b52ca96e6558d1]{HC4.2} and interrupt Kit's second appointment in HC6.4. LONDON INTERIORS

Venue Register

160 interiors and 51 approaches across twenty districts — and the four interiors the opening uses.

Every place a commission or case visits is here: who you meet there, its room key, where its door sits on the street map, and when the crew can first get in.

The maps

Every venue is MAPPED: its own scene in the London Venues compendium, six keyed rooms whose zone plaques carry the room codes (DA7.2 is room 2 of DA7), a public entry at room 1 and a secondary or loading arrival at room 6, each with its way out. 101 venues open straight off the street; the other 59 sit behind one of 51 approach maps (a park, a yard, a square, a side street), which has an ENTER pin for each venue's front door and a SERVICE pin for its back way in.

On each street map an ENTER pin marks the way in. A character walking into it goes through (the venue or approach is imported from the compendium on the spot); vehicles park outside. To get a mission ready, open the Mission Board and press Prepare this mission's maps; the scenes are filed under The Smoke — Venues, one folder per district. The sat nav routes to the entrance pin.

Four access states

Record each interior as Known (an actionable lead), Entered (a visit has happened), Trusted (a named repeat arrangement is earned) or Claimed (fictional premises only, with an agreed stake), with the sponsor and the permission alongside.
